profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary:
Keeping our skies safe, one bit at time.

My coding journey began in high school, deeply involved in FIRST robotics, sparking my passion for technology. Despite a college education in Psychology, my path led me to software engineering. I embraced this shift, earning a second degree in Computer Science with a focus on Software Engineering—an incredibly fulfilling choice!

Proficient in Java, C++, C, and Python, I continuously expand my skill set. Excited about the dynamic nature of software development, I am committed to contributing to innovations that enhance aviation safety.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Apache Modernization Developer

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description: Air Force F-15EX Tester

positions.title: Training Manager
positions.description:
• Collaborated with talent acquisition and HR to successfully recruit and onboard 1500+ external hires annually.
• Proficiently utilized Workday tool to manage employee performance, resignations, and separations.
• Oversaw and edited contact center Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure efficiency and compliance.
• Systematically maintained records of training activities, participant progress, and assessed training program effectiveness.
positions.insights: Skills: Workday · Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) · SharePoint · Training Delivery

positions.title: Training Supervisor
positions.description:
• Effectively supervised a team of 25 instructors, overseeing testing and delivery of training programs.
• Proactively identified performance issues, implemented corrective actions, and recommended termination for individuals not meeting training class performance criteria.
• Played a key role in the onboarding and management of new hire employees, contributing to a seamless integration into the training program.

positions.title: Bilingual Technical Instructor
positions.description:
• Instructed classes for Contact Center Customer Service Representatives, covering both Medicare and Marketplace services.
• Proactively identified performance issues, offered corrective action, and recommended termination for Customer Service Representatives not meeting training class performance criteria.
• Facilitated Supervisor and Leadership classes for managers, supervisors, and support staff, contributing to professional development and team effectiveness.

positions.title: Quality Alignment Specialist
positions.description:
•	Conducted classes for Contact Center Customer Service Representatives for both Medicare and Marketplace.
•	Identified performance issues, provide corrective action and suggest termination for Customer Service Representatives not meeting performance criteria in the training class.
•	Conducted Supervisor and Leadership classes for managers, supervisors and support staff.

positions.title: Medicare Benefits Specialist
positions.description:
* Provided knowledgeable responses to telephone inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.
* Maintained a current understanding of the processing procedures to respond to numerous phone inquiries.
* Adhered to the Privacy Act as it relates to the confidentiality of information released. 
* Responded to telephone inquiries within the departmental goals for quality, schedule adherence and average handle time.

positions.title: Medicare Benefits Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provided knowledgeable responses to telephone and chat inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.
•	Researched general inquiries and conducted advanced claims research. 
•	Responded to telephone inquiries within the departmental goals for quality, schedule adherence and average handle time.
